name: Wendy Wang
office: City of San Gabriel, Member of the City Council

items.text: She is a businesswoman, nonprofit executive, and care provider. She organized youth volunteer projects with the CIRC Youth Education & Empowerment Foundation.

sentences.text: She is a businesswoman, nonprofit executive, and care provider.
She organized youth volunteer projects with the CIRC Youth Education & Empowerment Foundation.

items.text: She advocates for a one-stop permit center for small businesses. She questioned the city's 25-year waste contract and a commercial rate increase of up to 60.8%. She calls for competitive bidding for waste-service contracts. She wants stronger oversight of the 11% sales tax and clearer reporting on how the money is spent. She proposes a Youth Commission to give young people a voice. She also wants to diversify local business types beyond boba tea shops and repair neglected roads.
